name: Public Records — Email Verifier (domain, MX and disposable check, not the mailbox) to HTTP
author: Public Records
description: Run publicrecords/email-verifier on YOUR Apify account via HTTP. It checks syntax, domain, MX records and disposable domains, not the mailbox, and does not send mail. Set APIFY_TOKEN in a Make connection or variable. Do not hard-code a token. Official Make gallery submission is not included.

metadata.notes: Rebuild in Make with the HTTP module if import of this blueprint is rejected; the URL, method, header and body are the recipe.
